statement_html:
Let \(u = \left( -11, \ 1, \ -4\right)\) be a space vector. We have another vector \(v\)whose length is 5. Given that the scalar product \(\langle u,v \rangle =-48\), what is the length of the vector product \(u\wedge v\) ?
Enter your reply:
=
hint_html: Decompose v into the sum of two vectors v<sub>1</sub> and v<sub>2</sub>,	where \(v_{1}\) is perpendicular to \(u\), and \(v_{2}\) is proportional	to \(u\).
